tool_suggestions.title: Meeting Engagement Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a web-based dashboard to track meeting engagement levels and AI query usage for different user roles.
features: Visualize user meeting statistics (e.g., total meetings, duration)
Display AI query and response metrics by user
Filter meetings by platform, date, and type
Identify high-engagement meetings with performance scores

tool_suggestions.title: Subscription Impact Analyzer
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a tool to analyze the impact of different subscription plans on user behavior and company revenue.
features: Track revenue generated by each subscription tier
Analyze features usage per plan (e.g., AI queries, CRM integrations)
Compare user retention rates across tiers
Graph subscription growth trends over time

tool_suggestions.title: Integration Health Tracker
tool_suggestions.prompt: Design an interface to monitor and manage the health status of third-party integrations for users.
features: List and view the status of all active integrations for users
Show sync history and errors for each integration
Enable/disable integrations from a central dashboard
Receive alerts for failed integrations or pending syncs
